project.name: Ludwig common framework
project.description: Reactor root for the Ludwig platform. This POM aggregates the build and is the parent of the library modules; it is no longer the registry of dependency versions (that is ludwig-bom) and it is not what a microservice inherits (that is ludwig-service-parent).

requirePluginVersions.message: Every plugin must declare a version. Add it to this POM's pluginManagement, not to the plugin block.

evaluateBeanshell.message: .mvn/maven.config must hold a -SNAPSHOT revision: it is the fallback for a checkout with no tags, not the release version. A release is a tag, and the version reaches Maven as -Drevision from GitVersion.

requireReleaseDeps.message: A release must not depend on a SNAPSHOT.

evaluateBeanshell.message: CHANGELOG.md has no "## [${project.version}]" heading. Add the entry before tagging the release.
CHANGELOG.ru.md has no "## [${project.version}]" heading. Both locales carry the same heading set; the Russian one is missing this release.
